class.name: MeshInstanceEx3D
class.brief_description: Node that instances a mesh and adds fast yet accurate UV lookup and texture sampling.
class.description:
[MeshInstanceEx3D] extends [MeshInstance3D] with two convenient features that are frequently needed in 3D games and editors. - [b]UV lookup from a world position[/b] – after a ray-cast or any world-space query you can retrieve the UV that belongs to the triangle nearest to the hit point. - [b]Color sampling from a texture[/b] – if you supply a [Texture2D], you can read the pixel color that corresponds to the UV returned by the lookup.
The node automatically rebuilds its internal cache when the mesh changes or when [code]invalidate_cache()[/code] is called. The cache can be tuned with [code]cache_division[/code], which determines the resolution of the 3D spatial grid used for acceleration. [MeshInstanceEx3D] employs a hybrid optimization approach that combines brute-force techniques for lightweight meshes with spatial partitioning for high-poly meshes. [b]A larger division reduces the number of triangles per cell but increases memory usage.[/b]

method.name: get_uv_at_position
method.description: Returns the UV coordinates of the triangle that is geometrically closest to [code]world_point[/code]. If the mesh has no geometry or no triangle is found, [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] is returned.

method.name: get_color_from_uv
method.description: Returns the pixel color from the [code]id_map[/code] texture that corresponds to the UV [code]hit_uv[/code]. If no [code]id_map[/code] is set or the texture cannot be read, a transparent color is returned.

method.name: invalidate_cache
method.description: Marks the internal triangle cache as dirty. The next call to [code]get_uv_at_position()[/code] will rebuild the cache. Call this method when the mesh resource changes at runtime (for example, when swapping meshes or modifying a mesh instance’s surface data).

members.member: Resolution of the 3D spatial grid used for spatial acceleration.
Texture used for sampling pixel data that corresponds to the UV of a triangle hit. Useful for ID maps or custom data packed into a texture.
